The subject is paperwork queues
Paperwork Queues at the Companion Animal Travel Desk

Travelers need to bring complete pet papers early so check-in can move smoothly.

If you are flying with a companion animal, please keep forms easy to reach and follow the staff directions at the desk. Small gaps in paperwork can slow the handoff, and our team will do what we can to keep things calm for you and your pet.

Please also make a note of the pet area details shared at the desk before you head onward. <<FACT F027>> Keep your travel folder in order, and let the staff know right away if anything changes in your plan. <<FACT F016>> That helps us update the desk ledger and keep the next step clear.

For help with any pet travel step, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
